name: codex-claude-bridge
description: Local stdio bridge that lets Claude Code delegate tasks and native image generation to the signed-in Codex CLI. Starting a task or an image job runs a Codex agent (writes inside the given folder; may request more, which the user approves in Claude Code by default) and answering such a request needs review. Status, wait and cancel inherit. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep codex_task_start and codex_image_generate on Review: each call runs a Codex agent with your normal Codex config, plugins and MCP servers under a workspace-write sandbox bounded to the given folder.
Register with CODEX_BRIDGE_MODE=image-only when you only need images; it hides codex_task_start and refuses direct calls to it.
Keep the default approval mode ask (or deny): Codex requests outside the sandbox then pause for your decision in Claude Code. CODEX_APPROVAL_MODE=bypass approves every such request.
Use codex_task_status, codex_task_wait and codex_status to follow jobs; they start nothing.
